records.title: Brazil, Bossa Nova & Blues
records.editionNotes: The same six-track album under its original title, Brazil, Bossa Nova & Blues. The photographed Brazil Blues jacket is a 1972 reissue.
records.availabilityNote: All six public tracks were marked playable when checked; availability can vary by region.
programmeProof: Family IMG_3677 rear lists six selections in the same order and explicitly identifies UAJ 15009 / SS 18020 as earlier issues.
Universal Music’s publisher page lists the original-title album, matching six-track programme and Blue Note UPC 00602577328909.
The public Spotify album has Herbie Mann, Capitol 1962 copyright and all six titles in order.

records.durationCaveat: The photographed rear prints no durations. Secondary UAS 5636 metadata lists B.N. Blues as 3:35, whereas the rights-holder digital original is about 2:55. Do not claim literal LP label timing equivalence; the printed reissue relationship and complete programme establish album identity.

records.unresolvedReason: Two Hallmark digital albums reproduce all fourteen GNP-9001 titles in exactly the original sequence, but neither identifies the Nuages master/take. The physical rear explicitly distinguishes a repeat take with the verse omitted and a different Django solo. A title/sequence/duration match alone does not prove that performance. Keep search-only under the exact-performance rule unless an independent publisher or audio comparison resolves the take.
records.candidateNote: 2010 Hallmark edition has all fourteen tracks; thirteen were marked playable. The 2009 Hallmark edition has ten playable and an artist-name typo in its title. Both remain candidates, not accepted canonical links.
